raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) arrived with lowercase customer_ids (e.g. 'c00180' instead of 'C00180'). That is why customer_id has 365 distinct values against 200 customers. The case-sensitive join to silver_customers drops those rows (4630 - 4267 = 363 POSTED rows), and gold_customer_spend splits each affected customer into two keys. Fix: normalize customer_id to upper case and trim it in silver_transactions and silver_customers.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'", "silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers"}}
